reasons: No tests are visible in this packet.

terms.meaning: a named value that CSS can reuse by name
a pattern used to search text
a stored copy so a file is not read again each time

sections.name: File setup, memo
sections.title: Imports and stored copy
sections.what: Brings in file reading and path helpers, and sets up a small store so the stylesheet is read only once.
sections.why: Likely reason: avoids reading the file every time a share image is made.
sections.watch_out: The stored copy never clears, so edits to tokens.css need a restart to take effect.

sections.name: tokensCss
sections.title: Reads the token stylesheet
sections.what: Reads the text of tokens.css, reusing the stored copy after the first read.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps tokens.css as the single source of colour values.
sections.watch_out: The path is relative to the current working folder, so starting the program from another folder breaks it.

sections.name: tokenValues
sections.title: Finds each token value
sections.what: For each requested name, finds its first declaration in tokens.css, and if that points to another token, follows the link up to five steps. Unknown names throw an error.
sections.why: Likely reason: values in the file often refer to other values, so following the links gives the final value.
sections.watch_out: It takes the first match, which is the light theme block, so dark values are never returned.

summary: Reads the light-theme colour and size values from tokens.css and returns them as plain text, for image makers that cannot read CSS variables.
purpose: Lets server-made share images use the same colours as the website.
why: The comment says it is for renderers such as next/og share images that cannot read CSS variables.
how: Reads tokens.css once and keeps a stored copy. For each requested name, finds its value and follows references to other names up to five steps. Returns a map from name to value.
inputs: A list of token names, such as the names of colours.
outputs: A map from each name to its literal value, such as a hex colour.
risks: It reads the file using a path from the current working folder, so it fails if the program starts elsewhere. It returns only light-theme values.
debug: If it throws an unknown token error, check the spelling and that tokens.css defines the name. If the file cannot be read, check the working folder.
